criteria.text: Identifies the threatened $2,750,000 claim by Eskdale Engineering Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Eskdale Robotics Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Flags that the board minutes and the disclosure letter are inconsistent about litigation.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Eskdale Robotics Ltd as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
